content: Full data-integration platforms (Airbyte, Meltano/Singer, dlt) add connector catalogs, CDC (mostly batch, only some support real-time), schema registries, lineage, dbt/SQL compatibility, permissioning and retry orchestration on top of the basic extract-load loop. Singer connector quality varies widely. Self-hosting these is 'free' in license cost but adds real engineering overhead for deployment/monitoring/upgrades/connector maintenance -- overhead not justified for a 2-dataset local project, which is why lightweight custom pipelines remain common for narrow, fixed-schema ingestion.
